Watch: Who is Greif?

Creating

packaging solutions

for life's essentials.

Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums, intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty products. 

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States. Greif is strategically positioned in more than 40 countries to serve customers of all sizes and needs.

Greif 2030 Sustainability Targets

2030 SUSTAINABILITY TARGETS

These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement in 2021 to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

The broader sustainability focus for the company continues to be advancing a circular economy, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and championing diversity, equity & inclusion initiatives.

Learn More
Target One: Waste

97%

Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities

By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets 97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills by 2030.

Learn More
Target Two: Circularity

100%

Make 100% of its Products Recyclable 

Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

Learn More
Target Three: CIRCULARITY

60%

Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products

Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

Learn More
Target Four: DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

=

Attain Global Gender Pay Parity

Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work by 2024 and is committed to maintaining gender pay parity.

Learn More
Target Five: Suppliers

80%

Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers

By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can have a greater impact across its value chain.

Learn More

GREIF LAUNCHES 2023 SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Greif’s 2023 Sustainability Report covers our fiscal year from November 1, 2022, through October 31, 2023. This report is prepared in accordance with the GRI Standards and SASB Application Guidance and fulfills the United Nations Global Compact’s (UNGC) annual Communication on Progress (COP).

VIEW SUMMARY

Behind every glowing candle, festive meal, and cherished decoration is packaging that makes it all possible. We’re proud to support celebrations across the globe, bringing joy from our hands to yours.

To our colleagues and customers, your dedication and partnership make everything possible. We couldn’t do it without you!

Introducing 
ModCan™

ModCan™ is an innovation born in a lab and brought to you for maximizing space in a modular use case of a barrel or drum.  

  • Maximized Space and Cost Efficiency
  • Versatility and Compatability
  • Ergonomic and Safe Design
  • Sustainability Benefits
Learn More
WATCH VIDEO

Introducing 
GCUBE IBC Shield

GCUBE IBC Shield helps protect oxygen-sensitive and solvent-based products from gas permeation during storage and transport. With barrier technology built into both the bottle and valve, it helps preserve product quality, extend shelf life, and maintain effectiveness while offering the same flexibility as a standard GCUBE IBC.

  • Extends shelf life by reducing oxygen ingress and protecting product quality
  • Minimizes solvent, aroma, and volatile compound loss to maintain product effectiveness
  • Delivers complete barrier protection across both the bottle and valve, eliminating weak points
  • Offers the same configuration flexibility as a standard GCUBE IBC, including specialized food-contact, light-protection, and antistatic options
  • Meets ADR permeability standards for demanding applications while remaining fully recyclable
Learn More
WATCH VIDEO

Sustainability in Action

Recycling

Greif paper packaging is a net-positive recycler. Creating materials from scratch has a significant impact on the environment. Contact us about our recycling services, including collecting paper, paperboard, and plastics, to developing custom solutions.

Learn More

Green Tool

Calculate your carbon footprint with Greif. Both easy and cost-effective, the Greif Green Tool provides insight into the environmental impact of packaging used for fillers and emptiers. It makes local reporting seamless and empowers smart sustainability choices.

Learn More
View All GREIF Services

Greif Barrier Technology

We design and manufacture containers that do more than hold products, they actively protect what matters most. Greif’s expertise in barrier science and technology helps keep your product exactly where it belongs: inside the package, not absorbed into the container walls or released into the surrounding environment.

  • Reduces Emissions And Leakage Risks
  • Maintains Product Purity During Storage And Transport
  • Protects Against Oxygen, Moisture And Chemical Exposure
  • Customizable Barrier Solutions For Your Specific Needs
Learn More

THINK OUTSIDE THE DRUM WITH DRUM360

Your drums don’t have to blend in, make them bold. Drum360 gives you the freedom to showcase vibrant, full-color designs that amplify your brand wherever it goes. From events to retail displays to everyday packaging needs, these drums are more than containers, they’re your next big marketing moment.

  • Full-spectrum printing for maximum visual impact
  • Tailored designs that reflect your brand identity
  • Endless creative possibilities for packaging and beyond

Giving Back and Building a Better Tomorrow

Greif is committed to building a better tomorrow by giving back to our communities today. At Greif, we aim to create thriving communities where we live and work. Following The Greif Way, we strive to create a culture that supports the common good by using our financial and human resources to support charitable organizations focusing on education, health, and social services.
